code:
FROM node:20-slim AS build
WORKDIR /app
RUN npm install --production
COPY . .

FROM node:20-slim
RUN useradd --create-home catalog
USER catalog
caption: Build stage installs dependencies; the runtime stage switches to a non-root user before it ever listens.

eyebrow: compose.yaml -- the wiring that makes it one app
code:
catalog-db:
  volumes: [catalog-db-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data]
  healthcheck:
    test: ["pg_isready"]
checkout:
  depends_on:
    catalog-db:
      condition: service_healthy
caption: checkout won't start taking traffic until catalog-db's health check actually passes.

code:
$ docker compose up -d
$ docker compose ps
NAME        STATUS
catalog     Up (healthy)
catalog-db  Up (healthy)
checkout    Up
$ curl -X POST localhost:8081/api/checkout ...
{"orderId": "ord_8841", "status": "confirmed"}
caption: A real order confirmation -- checkout reached catalog and catalog-db by name over the network.
